**Thank you for your contribution. Please ensure your pull request meets the following:**

- [ ] Builds without warnings or errors (`pnpm build`, autofix with `pnpm format:fix`)
- [ ] Pull request targets the `main` branch
- [ ] Commits follow the [conventional commits guideline](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/)
- [ ] No shorthand variable names are used (e.g. `x`, `y`, `i`, or any abbreviation)
- [ ] Documentation is up to date (`apps/docs` and the README)
- [ ] When using AI: no temp files are checked in, and the code style follows the rest of the project

**When contributing a new integration or widget:**

- [ ] I confirmed manually that the integration or widget works with a real system and performed basic smoke tests (e.g. what happens if it is offline)
- [ ] Optional but recommended: I am willing to be added to `CODEOWNERS` for this feature and will provide support and maintain it (e.g. in case of breaking changes or failures)
